Subject: Reserved pool cadence and timebox request for dedicated capacity architecture review

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the productive call last week. BlueRiver's POC is progressing and we want to lock in a focused architecture review to align on: pool sizing, autoscaling timebox behavior, and isolation strategies for tenant workloads. Goal is a 90-minute technical deep-dive with clear next steps and action owners so your infra team can validate the capacity plan before procurement.

Proposed high-level agenda (attached as PDF):
- 10 min: goals and constraints (your side)
- 25 min: Redwood dedicated runtime overview (we'll cover batching & KV cache)
- 25 min: pool sizing & quantization recommendations (interactive)
- 20 min: autoscale runbook and burst behavior (SLOs & cooldowns)
- 10 min: isolation modes, failover, and fallback policies

Availability from our side: Mon/Tue next week in the 14:00–18:00 UTC window. Can you share 2x preferred time slots and who from your infra/security team will join? I can send a calendar invite and attach the draft sizing spreadsheet in advance.

Attachments: reserved-pool-proposed-agenda.pdf, pool-sizing-table.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Sofia Ivanova
